ui.story.name: Raju
ui.story.b1: A convincing message can hide a harmful request. Let us practise checking the evidence.
ui.story.b2: These are fictional phones. Explore messages, find pressure tactics, and pin the clues.
ui.story.b3: Then rebuild the sequence and choose a safer response. You can ask for hints or take a break.
ui.story.b4: Close the cases, solve a mystery, and build your own safety playbook.
